# Shrimp SD

> Freshwater shrimp specialist in San Diego, California. The shrimp desk of Pet Zone Tropical Fish, an aquascaping-focused local fish store in the Convoy District. Neocaridina, Caridina, and algae-crew species, held on San Diego tap water so local buyers get no parameter shock.

## Key facts

- **Business:** Shrimp SD, the shrimp department of Pet Zone Tropical Fish
- **Address:** 4160 Convoy St, San Diego, CA 92111
- **Phone:** (858) 987-0309
- **Email:** help@petzonesd.com
- **Hours:** Open 7 days, 10am–6pm
- **Online store:** https://www.petzonesd.com/shrimp/
- **Fulfilment:** collect in store, or ship nationwide under the Pet Zone live arrival guarantee

## What makes the water claim specific

San Diego tap water is moderately hard and sits naturally in the Neocaridina comfort range (GH 6-8, TDS 150-250). Shrimp SD holds its Neocaridina on that same dechlorinated tap water, so a local buyer's tank is already the water the shrimp grew in. San Diego water is chloraminated, so it must be treated every time — leaving a bucket to stand does not work. Caridina are the exception and require RO water remineralised to a lower TDS on buffering substrate.
